notes: One PCB; USB-C power (5V, 1A current limit) and USB data; USB-ground referenced.
Install exactly one matching pair of range jumpers with power removed.
OPA2810 analog architecture from TIDA-060029; no BUF634A; feedback closes at actual OPA2810 output.
Engineering prototype; no inherited 0.1% system accuracy. Isolated, discharged DUT only.

Revision C uses one local C104=100pF directly from TIA output to summing input on all ranges, bypassing the RF jumper. C41/C105 removed. Rev C-local100p firmware/calibration identity required; high-range feedback pole15.9kHz reduces sensitivity at100kHz.

Rev C FDA stability: ADS9224REVM SBAU315B feedback topology, 22R inside each feedback loop (EVM uses 10R), 1k || 100pF feedback and 4.32R outside. RGT optional FB pins intentionally NC; external feedback senses after 22R. REFby2 remains directly connected with C74 1uF, rather than EVM per-driver 100R/100nF VOCM branches.
